source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.quote: Through the agreement, Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine.
source.note: The extension covers BAL Finals in 2024, 2026 and 2028, so it covers the 2026 season. pr.nba.com (2026-01-30, https://pr.nba.com/basketball-africa-league-sixth-season/) confirms 'Rwanda Development Board will return as BAL Foundational Partner' for 2026; Into Rwanda (2026-04-13) describes a 'Visit Rwanda' logo on every player's jersey at BAL games in Kigali.

source.name: BAL (bal.nba.com): BAL names PUMA as league's official outfitter ahead of 2026 season
source.quote: will see PUMA supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms
source.note: Kit maker (Official Outfitter of the BAL from the 2026 season), not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

summary: League-controlled BAL uniform: PUMA is the league's official outfitter from the 2026 season and Visit Rwanda stays on BAL team uniforms under the RDB extension. No club-level shirt sponsor found for the Giants' debut BAL season.
